newsitem.title: FRANCE: France asks Israel to lift West Bank closure.
newsitem.headline: France asks Israel to lift West Bank closure.

text.p: France on Thursday called on Israel to lift the closure of the West Bank to allow Palestinians access to Jerusalem holy places.

A Foreign Ministry statement said the closure, besides endangering Palestinian economy, was even more unpopular among Palestinians during the current Aid al-Kebir Moslem festival as it barred worshippers from visiting the holy places.

"French authorities are very concerned by the effects of the new closure of the West Bank...France wishes that all Palestinians, whatever their religion, be allowed free access to the Holy places," it said.

Israel sealed off the West Bank last Tuesday, saying it had warnings that Palestinian guerrillas were planning an attack on Israelis. Tension has soared since Israel last month launched construction on a Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem which Palestinians view as the capital of their future state.
